reasons: Financial pressure (3 of 4: going concern / covenant problem / revenue-EPS incentive pay / capital raise): three of four pressure flags present is a strong incentive signal for earnings management, the most concerning area on the card.

Prior-period corrections and accounting changes (1 of 3): one restatement/revision, voluntary accounting change or segment change; a correction or discretionary change heightens concern about reporting reliability.

Transaction complexity (3 of 8): moderate complexity (e.g. over-time revenue, contract assets, acquisitions, write-downs, concentration) gives room for judgmental accounting but is not extreme.
Numeric warning signals (1 of 3 computable): one of Beneish M, Dechow F, accruals or cash-flow-vs-income tests is tripped; modest quantitative support.
